source_caption_text:
honestav really took the term “crowd surfing” literally 😂😂😭

Honestav’s numbers started with one record.
The 2024 song that put him on Billboard is sitting around 89 million Spotify streams. That’s the one that turned him from clips into a touring artist.

After that: “Stuck On The Floor” is over 27 million. “Crash First” with MGK is over 16 million and hit No. 1 on iTunes Alternative. “Growin’ Pains” is over 12 million.

Whole catalog is past 250 million Spotify streams. Around 1.6 million monthly listeners. Debut project hara-kiri in 2024, deluxe in 2025. Follow-up album Sweet American Boy peaked at No. 4 on Spotify’s Top Album Debuts.
That’s the run. One breakthrough song into a full catalog and sold-out dates.
